exchanges: Hello! I am in Ottawa now, I arrived from Curitiba on Sunday.
Welcome! That's a long trip. How are you feeling?
Tired but happy. I am staying with a host family for my first semester.
A host family is a great way to land somewhere new. What are they like?
Very nice. The mom is Maria and the dad is Pierre, and they have two little boys.
Sounds like a lively house. Are the boys excited to have you?
Yes they want to teach me hockey lol. I said I have never been on ice in my life.
Kids love teaching that. Skating takes a few tries but you'll pick it up.
The dad works strange hours, he is a firefighter, so sometimes he sleeps in the day and we must be quiet.
Shift work is tough on a household. Good that everyone knows to keep it down.
They have a dog too, Maple, a big yellow labrador. She sleeps on my feet.
A built-in foot warmer for the winter. Lucky you.
Haha yes. Grandma lives with them also, she was a librarian for forty years and she gives me books for my English.
That's a wonderful resource to have at home. Reading with her will help a lot.
Her hands hurt a lot because of arthritis so I help her open jars.
That's kind of you. Small help like that means a lot.
My English classes at the university start tomorrow. Bridge program before my real degree.
Bridge programs are a smart way to ease in. What's your degree going to be?
Biology. I want to do research later.
Great field for research. The bridge term will help with all the technical reading.
First day was good! There are students from everywhere.
That mix is one of the best parts of those programs. Did you meet anyone?
A Korean guy named Jiho, he is very funny. He will study economics after the program.
Sounds like a fun classmate to have.
And a girl named Maria, from Spain. Same name as my host mom, so now I say Spanish Maria and host Maria.
That's a practical system. How is the new one?
Super nice. She plays the ukulele and brought it to the break, everyone was singing.
That's a quick way to make a class feel like friends.
I cannot see the board well. Too far away. Everything is blurry.
That's worth getting checked. A lot of people only notice that once they're in a big classroom.
Host Maria made me an appointment with her eye doctor, Dr. Tremblay.
That's helpful of her. An eye exam should sort it out quickly.
He said I have astigmatism and I need glasses. I am a little sad, I never had glasses.
It's very common, and glasses can look really good. You'll probably be surprised how sharp everything looks.
I chose blue frames. They will be ready next week.
Blue frames sound fun. Something to look forward to.
Tonight host Maria played music after dinner, she plays the cello in a community orchestra.
Live music after dinner, that's a lovely house to land in.
It was beautiful. The boys were dancing.
Sounds like a really warm evening.
Oh, I said wrong before. Jiho is not studying economics, he told me today it's statistics. I confused it.
Easy to mix those up, they overlap a lot. Thanks for the correction.
He laughed and said everyone thinks that.
He's probably used to explaining it by now.
It snowed today!!! The first snow of my life!
That's a big moment! How did it feel?
Cold. Very cold. But so beautiful. Maple was running in it like crazy.
Dogs love the first snow. Did you go out too?
Yes the boys threw snowballs at me. I need a better jacket.
A proper winter jacket is a must here. Outlet stores can have good deals.
Pierre said he will take me to buy one on Saturday.
Good to have someone who knows what works in these winters.
My glasses are ready. I can see every leaf on the trees now, it is crazy.
That's such a great feeling. Welcome to high definition.
Spanish Maria said she moved here from Valencia only last month, so she is new too.
That's nice, you can explore the city together as fellow newcomers.
Yes we want to go to the museum this weekend. The nature one.
The Canadian Museum of Nature is great, especially for a future biologist.
She said there are dinosaurs, I am excited.
The fossil gallery is a highlight. Enjoy it!

questions.message: My host mom is musical right? What's her instrument?
What was my eye problem called again?
Where did Spanish Maria come from?
What does host Maria do for work?
I hope there is a gift shop, I want a postcard for my mom.
